title: Routines
description: What a Bot does on a schedule, without being asked each time. Made and changed by talking to a Bot — this page only shows what is standing, and lets you stop one.

workerStalled.title: Nothing is running these
workerStalled.lastChecked: The routines worker last checked {{when}}. Until it is running again, none of these will fire.
workerStalled.neverChecked: No routines worker has ever checked in, so none of these will fire. A deployment needs one running to carry them out.

loadError: Your routines could not be loaded.

empty.title: Nothing scheduled
empty.hint: Ask a Bot — "every weekday at 9, …" — and it will appear here.
empty.agentHint: Ask it in a channel — "every weekday at 9, …" — and it will appear here.

actions.runNowTitle: Runs it for real, now: the Bot does the work and posts in the channel.
actions.runNowPausedTitle: Paused routines never run. Switch it on first.
actions.historyAria: Run history for the routine scheduled {{schedule}}

delete.title: Delete "{{schedule}}"?
delete.description: This standing instruction stops for good. Nothing further runs on this schedule, and there is no undo.

responsibilities.title: Goals
responsibilities.emptyForBot: No responsibilities for this Bot yet.

new.heading: New responsibility
new.description: A lasting goal, worked on in the conversation you pick.
new.titlePlaceholder: Keep the customer report up to date
new.criteriaPlaceholder: The report contains the current quarter's graph and a source link.
new.eventsFrom: Events come from the repositories you connected in <link>Settings → Connected accounts</link>.

dialog.activeDescription: Its events and triggers start runs.
dialog.pausedDescription: Paused. Its triggers are acknowledged but never run it.
dialog.runNowDescription: Runs it for real, now: the Bot does the work and can post and act.
dialog.completeDescription: Mark it done. Nothing starts it after this.
dialog.waitingFor: Waiting for {{kind}}. Respond at the top of this Bot's page, or in the conversation.

kindHelp.webhook: POST JSON to the URL with the authorization header (or Standard Webhooks signature headers). 200 means accepted and queued, not finished.
kindHelp.github: In the repository's Settings → Webhooks, set the payload URL to this URL, content type application/json, and the secret to the key.
kindHelp.linear: In Linear, Settings → API → Webhooks: set the URL, then paste the signing secret Linear shows here.
kindHelp.sentry: In a Sentry internal integration, set the webhook URL, then paste the integration's client secret here.
kindHelp.pagerduty: In PagerDuty, Integrations → Generic Webhooks (v3): set the URL, then paste the secret shown on creation here.
kindHelp.email: Send or forward mail to this address to start a run.
kindHelp.slack: Fires from Slack events delivered through this Bot's Slack pairing. Messages from before the trigger existed are ignored.

filter.inEveryChannel: in every channel the Bot is in

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.addDescription: Something outside OpenBot that starts this responsibility.
triggers.statusNote: This responsibility is {{status}}, so its triggers are acknowledged but never run it.
triggers.none: No triggers. It runs when you press Run now, or on the event subscriptions above.
triggers.inboundEmailWarning: Inbound email is not configured on this deployment (OPENBOT_INBOUND_EMAIL_DOMAIN and OPENBOT_INBOUND_EMAIL_SNS_TOPIC_ARNS), so this address cannot receive mail yet.
triggers.pasteNewSecret: Paste a new secret to rotate
triggers.channelIds: Channel IDs (blank: all the Bot is in)
